name: Chicken Timbales II
author: Fannie Merritt Farmer (1896)
steps: Melt butter, add bread crumbs and milk, and cook five minutes, stirring constantly.
Add chicken, parsley, and eggs slightly beaten.
Turn into buttered individual moulds, having moulds two-thirds full set in pan of hot water, cover with buttered paper, and bake twenty minutes.

culture.text: From The Boston Cooking-School Cook Book (1896) by Fannie Merritt Farmer. It popularized level, standardized measurements (cups and spoons) in American home kitchens, and stayed one of the best-selling cookbooks in the United States for decades.
